units.title: Networking Essential
topics: 1.1. Models of Network Computing - Centralized Computing - Distributed Computing - Collaborative Computing
1.2. Client Server Network and Peer to Peer Network
1.3. Need of layered mechanism
1.4. OSI Model - Responsibilities of each layer
1.5. TCP/IP Protocol Suite - Comparison of TCP/IP with OSI model - List of Protocols at each layer of TCP/IP and a brief description of each protocol
1.6. Data Traffic - Traffic descriptor - Traffic profiles
1.7. Congestion - Network Performance
1.8. Congestion Control - Open-Loop Congestion Control - Closed-Loop Congestion Control
uos: 1.a. Differentiate different models of Network Computing.
1.b. Explain OSI Model and TCP/IP of each layer.
1.c. Describe Data traffic and Congestion Management.

units.title: Protocol and Addressing Scheme
topics: 2.1. ARP,RARP (Introduction)
2.2. Routing - Types of routing - Routing table
2.3. SMTP, POP, IMAP (Introduction)
2.4. Introduction to WWW and HTTP/S
2.5. Data link layer protocols - Simplest, stop and wait, stop and wait ARQ

2.6. IPv4 addressing scheme - Classful and classless notations - Ipv4 datagram header - Subnetting and Supernetting - Network address translation - Advantages, Disadvantages Mobile Computing and Networks Course Code: 4351602
2.7. IPV6 Addressing - Need for IPv6 migration - IPv6 advantages
uos: 2.a. Explain different protocols of the OSI layer.
2.b. Explain IPv4 and IPv6 addressing scheme.
2.c. Describe Subnetting and Supernetting of IPv4.

units.title: Introduction to Mobile Computing.
topics: 3.1. Evolution of Mobile Computing
3.2. Architecture for Mobile Computing
3.3. Networks (Brief) - Wireless Networks - Ad-hoc networks - Bearer
3.4. Middleware and Gateways (Brief) - Communication middleware - Transaction processing Communication middleware - Behavior management middleware - Communication Gateways
3.5. Application and Services
3.6. Security and Standards
uos: 3.d. List out Application of Mobile Computing.

topics: 4.1. Mobile IP - Goals, assumptions and requirements - Entities and terminology
4.2. Packet Delivery, handover management and Location management
4.3. Registration, Tunneling and encapsulation
4.4. Dynamic host configuration (Introduction)
4.5. Indirect TCP, snooping TCP and Mobile TCP
4.6. TCP over 3.0 G mobile
uos: 4.a. Explain Packet Delivery, handover management and Location management.
4.b. Differentiate Indirect TCP, snooping TCP and Mobile TCP.

units.title: Technologies in Trends
topics: 5.1. WLAN - Introduction of WLAN - Architecture of WLAN - Types of WLAN
5.2. WPAN - Introduction of WPAN - Applications in WPAN - Bluetooth, architecture and Bluetooth protocol stack
